tips.label: 問天氣
tips.text: 用 How is/was the weather ...? 或 What is/was the weather like ...? 來問天氣。

tips.label: 回答天氣
tips.text: 用 It is/was + 天氣形容詞回答，例如 It was rainy. 注意這裡用 It，不用 This 或 That。

tips.label: 易混淆句型
tips.text: It snows/snowed 的 snow 是動詞；It is/was snowy 的 snowy 是形容詞。There is/was + rain/snow 與 We/They have/had + rain/snow 都能表示某地有雨雪，但主詞與動詞不可混搭。

notes.title: How 與 What 詢問天氣
notes.rule: How + be 動詞 + the weather + 地點副詞 + 時間副詞？／What + be 動詞 + the weather + like + 地點副詞 + 時間副詞？
notes.description: How 的問句不能加 like；What 的問句一定要加 like。be 動詞依時間改成 is 或 was。
examples: How is the weather in Taipei today?
What was the weather like in Hsinchu last night?
How was the weather in Australia in summer?

notes.title: 回答天氣狀況
notes.rule: It + is / was + 天氣形容詞。
notes.description: 談天氣時用代名詞 It 代替 the weather。今天、現在等現在時間用 is；昨天、上週等過去時間用 was。
examples: It was rainy and wet yesterday.

notes.title: 描述雨量與雪量
notes.rule: It + rains/rained/snows/snowed + a lot/a little + 地點副詞 + 時間副詞。
notes.description: rain 與 snow 在這個句型是動詞；現在習慣或事實用 rains/snows，過去發生的事用 rained/snowed。snowy 是形容詞，必須搭配 It is/was snowy，後面不能再直接接 a lot 或 a little。
examples: It rains a lot in Taipei in winter.
It snowed a little in the mountains yesterday.

notes.title: There is/was 與 have 描述雨雪
notes.rule: There + is/was + a lot of/much/a little + rain/snow。／We/They + have + a lot of/much/a little + rain/snow。
notes.description: rain 與 snow 在這裡是不可數名詞，不能說 many rains。There 開頭要搭配 is/was；We/They 開頭要搭配 have/had。問句分別是 Is/Was there ...? 與 Do/Did we/they have ...?，兩套句型不可混搭。
examples: There was a lot of rain last summer.
We have much rain in spring.
They had a little snow in January.

quiz.question: ___ is the weather in the mountains today?
quiz.hint: 詢問天氣時，How is the weather 不加 like；若用 What，後面必須有 like。

quiz.question: ___ was the weather like at the harbor yesterday?
quiz.hint: 句中有 like，要用 What was the weather like；How 的天氣問句不加 like。

quiz.question: ___ was the weather during your winter vacation?
quiz.hint: 這個天氣問句沒有 like，所以用 How was the weather。

quiz.question: ___ is the weather like on the island now?
quiz.hint: 句中有 like，應用 What is the weather like，不能用 How。

quiz.question: What is the weather ___ near the lake today?
quiz.hint: What 詢問天氣需搭配 like；這裡的 like 不作動詞變化。

quiz.question: What was the weather ___ during the boat trip?
quiz.hint: What was the weather like 用來問過去的天氣，like 不會跟著變成 liked。

quiz.question: ___ the weather at the campsite now? It is sunny.
quiz.hint: 現在的天氣問句用 How is the weather；What is 的句型還需要 like。

quiz.question: ___ the weather like during the storm last night?
quiz.hint: last night 用 was；有 like 的天氣問句用 What was the weather like。

quiz.question: It ___ rainy in the village right now.
quiz.hint: right now 表示現在；rainy 是形容詞，描述天氣用 It is rainy，不用 have 或 has。

quiz.question: It ___ snowy at the campsite yesterday.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去；snowy 是形容詞，需用 It was snowy，不用 had。

quiz.question: It ___ windy near the sea at the moment.
quiz.hint: at the moment 指現在；windy 是形容詞，要用 is 連接。

quiz.question: It ___ cloudy during our picnic last Sunday.
quiz.hint: last Sunday 指過去；cloudy 是形容詞，前面用 was，不用 had 或 has。

quiz.question: Look outside! It ___ sunny now.
quiz.hint: now 表示現在；sunny 是形容詞，天氣主詞 It 後用 is。

quiz.question: It ___ cold on the island last night.
quiz.hint: last night 表示過去；cold 是形容詞，It 後用 was，不能用 had。

quiz.question: It is ___ near the harbor today.
quiz.hint: 這裡用 It is + 天氣形容詞，因此選 rainy；rain 是名詞或動詞，rains、rained 是動詞變化。

quiz.question: It was ___ in the mountains last weekend.
quiz.hint: was 後要接描述天氣的形容詞 snowy，不能直接接 snow、snows 或 snowed。

quiz.question: It is often ___ on this island in spring.
quiz.hint: is 後面要接天氣形容詞 rainy；often 不會改變這個句型。

quiz.question: It was ___ outside our cabin yesterday morning.
quiz.hint: It was 後用形容詞 snowy；若把 snow 當過去式動詞，應說 It snowed，不加 was。

quiz.question: It was ___ at the farm before the storm.
quiz.hint: 這裡已有 was，要接形容詞 rainy；It rained 是另一種句型，不可寫成 It was rained。

quiz.question: It is usually ___ in this village in January.
quiz.hint: 已有 is，因此用形容詞 snowy；若用動詞句型，應說 It usually snows。

quiz.question: It ___ a lot here every spring. The roads are often wet.
quiz.hint: every spring 表示習慣；It 後直接用第三人稱單數動詞 rains。a lot 修飾下雨的量，這裡不能填 has 或 is。

quiz.question: It ___ a little in the mountains every winter. The ground turns white.
quiz.hint: every winter 表示習慣，主詞 It 搭配 snows；a little 修飾下雪的量，不能用 have 或 is。

quiz.question: It ___ a lot during the storm yesterday. We needed umbrellas.
quiz.hint: yesterday 指過去，應用動詞 rained；It had 或 It was 後面只接 a lot 不能表達下雨。

quiz.question: It ___ a little at the ski resort last night. The roofs turned white.
quiz.hint: last night 指過去，要用 snowed；a little 修飾下雪的量，不用 had 或 was。

quiz.question: It usually ___ a lot in this area in June. Bring an umbrella.
quiz.hint: usually 表示習慣，It 搭配 rains；這是動詞句型，不用 have 或 is。

quiz.question: It often ___ a little here in January. We sometimes make small snowmen.
quiz.hint: often 表示習慣，It 搭配現在式 snows；不能把描述雨雪的 have 或 be 句型混進來。

quiz.question: It ___ a little during our walk yesterday. We opened our umbrellas.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去，用 rained；a little 前需要描述下雨的動詞，不是 have 或 was。

quiz.question: It ___ a lot in the village last December. We made snowmen.
quiz.hint: last December 表示過去，堆雪人的語境指出是下雪，要用 snowed，不用 has 或 was。

quiz.question: It ___ a lot near the lake every summer. We often carry umbrellas.
quiz.hint: every summer 表示習慣；It 後的現在式 rain 要加 s。has、was 都不能在此句表達下雨。

quiz.question: It ___ a little on this mountain every February. There is snow on the path.
quiz.hint: every February 表示習慣；主詞 It 搭配 snows，不用 have、was 或原形 snow。

quiz.question: It ___ a lot here last Friday. The rain kept us indoors.
quiz.hint: last Friday 是過去時間，用 rained；had、is 不能放入這個 It + 天氣動詞的句型。

quiz.question: It ___ a little at the farm yesterday. Snow covered part of the roof.
quiz.hint: yesterday 表示過去，snow 作動詞要用 snowed；have 或 is 不能直接搭配 a little 來表示下雪。

quiz.question: Does it ___ a lot here in May? Should I bring an umbrella?
quiz.hint: Does 後用原形 rain；這裡是下雨的動詞句型，不用 has 或 is，也不再加 s。

quiz.question: Did it ___ a little at the mountain hotel last night? Was the roof white?
quiz.hint: Did 已表示過去，後面用原形 snow，不能再用 snowed，也不能混用 had 或 was。

quiz.question: We ___ a lot of rain here every summer.
quiz.hint: 主詞 We 用 have + 雨雪名詞；rain 在 a lot of 後是名詞，不能把 We 當作 There 而接 is 或 are。

quiz.question: They ___ a little snow in their village every winter.
quiz.hint: 主詞 They 的現在式用 have，後面接名詞 snow；不能用 has、is 或 are。

quiz.question: We ___ a lot of rain during our trip last week.
quiz.hint: last week 表示過去，We 用 had + 名詞 rain；不能用 was 或 were 代替 had。

quiz.question: They ___ heavy snow in their town last January.
quiz.hint: last January 表示過去，They 用 had 描述當地雪量，不用 was 或 were。

quiz.question: We usually ___ very little rain in November.
quiz.hint: usually 表示習慣，主詞 We 搭配 have，後面是名詞 rain，不能用 be 動詞。

quiz.question: They ___ no rain during their holiday last month.
quiz.hint: last month 表示過去；They had no rain 表示當地沒下雨，不能用 was 或 were。

quiz.question: We have a lot of ___ in our town every spring.
quiz.hint: have a lot of 後需接名詞 rain；rainy 是形容詞，rains、rained 是動詞變化。

quiz.question: They had a little ___ during their winter vacation.
quiz.hint: had a little 後接不可數名詞 snow；不能用形容詞 snowy 或動詞 snows、snowed。

quiz.question: There ___ a lot of rain here every April.
quiz.hint: There 描述雨量用 is，不用 have 或 has；rain 是不可數名詞，即使有 a lot of 也不能用 are。

quiz.question: There ___ a little snow on this mountain every winter.
quiz.hint: There 後搭配 be 動詞；snow 是不可數名詞，現在的句型用 is，不用 are、have 或 has。

quiz.question: There ___ heavy rain in the village last night.
quiz.hint: last night 指過去，rain 是不可數名詞，要用 There was，不用 were 或 had。

quiz.question: There ___ a lot of snow near the lake last December.
quiz.hint: last December 指過去，snow 是不可數名詞，搭配 was；There 句型不能改用 had。

quiz.question: There ___ very little rain on this island every autumn.
quiz.hint: 描述固定季節的雨量用 There is；rain 不可數，不能用 are，也不能混用 have 或 has。

quiz.question: There ___ no snow at the campsite last weekend.
quiz.hint: last weekend 指過去，snow 不可數，There 後用 was，不用 were、has 或 had。

quiz.question: There is a lot of ___ in this area in summer.
quiz.hint: There is a lot of 後接名詞 rain；rainy 是形容詞，rains、rained 是動詞變化。

quiz.question: There was a little ___ on the hill yesterday.
quiz.hint: There was a little 後接不可數名詞 snow；不能用 snowy、snows 或 snowed。
